manual.title: Tasmota IR
manual.description: No Tasmota IR devices were auto-discovered. Enter the MQTT topic prefix manually.

pick.title: Tasmota IR
pick.description: Choose the Tasmota IR device to add.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the MQTT broker.

abort.already_configured: This Tasmota IR device is already configured.

add_climate_auto.title: Add AC (auto-detect)
add_climate_auto.description: Enter a friendly name and click Submit. Then within 20 seconds, point your AC's physical remote at the Tasmota receiver and press any button. The vendor (Daikin64, Mitsubishi, etc.) and the AC's current state are read straight from the captured IR signal.

add_remote.title: Add TV-style device
add_remote.description: A TV-style device exposes a remote.* entity where each button is learned individually.

add_climate.title: Add AC
add_climate.description: An AC exposes a climate.* entity. Tasmota generates the correct IR signal from mode/temp/fan — no learning needed, but the AC vendor must be one Tasmota recognises.

error.no_signal: No IR signal received within 20 seconds. Try again, closer to the receiver.
error.not_an_ac: Got an IR signal, but it didn't look like an AC remote (no IRHVAC payload). Try a different button on the AC remote, or use "Add an AC (pick vendor manually)".
